name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: An all-in-one, privacy-focused alternative to Notion and Miro for writing, planning, and whiteboarding that you can run on your own servers.
buyer: A law firm, healthcare practice, or EU-based company that can't put sensitive internal documents into Notion or Miro's cloud.
business_use_cases: A law firm self-hosts it internally for case notes and planning instead of Notion, satisfying client-confidentiality requirements.
An IT consultancy offers managed, self-hosted 'private Notion replacement' hosting for small businesses that want data sovereignty.
A healthcare startup uses the self-hosted version internally to stay compliant with data-residency rules while keeping a modern notes and whiteboard tool.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed self-hosting billed monthly to privacy-conscious small businesses.
Sell a one-off 'migrate off Notion to your own server' setup service.

steal_this: Offer a fixed-price 'private, self-hosted Notion setup in a weekend' package to two or three local law or healthcare offices.
